extensionDescription.message: Double-click (double tap) on a link to open it in a new Tab. Designed for tablets and laptop trackpads.

open_tab_next.message: Put new tab next to current tab

open_tab_end.message: Put new tab at the end

thankHeader.message: Thank you for installing Tap To Tab!

thankBody.message: You can double tap on any link to open it in a new tab. If you encounter any problems, feel free to contact us.
